This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]]. [[Tuut Orial]] was a member of this species.<ref name="Skeleton Crew" />

==Biology and appearance==
This [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their [[Color|pink]], textured skin, large [[nose]]s, and pointed [[ear]]s.<ref name="Skeleton Crew" />

==Species in the galaxy==
Around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> a member of this species, [[Tuut Orial]], worked as a [[merchant]] from a stall on [[Borgo Prime|Port Borgo]], selling [[flying attack droid]]s by tossing [[fruit]] in the air for the droids to slice through.<ref name="Skeleton Crew" />

==Behind the scenes==
This species first appeared in the [[Way, Way Out Past the Barrier|second episode]] of the television series ''[[Skeleton Crew]]'',<ref name="Skeleton Crew" /> which was released on [[December 2]], [[2024]].<ref name="Early">{{SW|url=news/skeleton-crew-premiere-date|text=''Star Wars: Skeleton Crew'' Will Debut Early|date=2024-11-26}}</ref>
